en.headline: Yellow Working Heat Stress Warning issued this afternoon
en.dek: The Labour Department activated the Yellow Working Heat Stress Warning around 1.15pm as heat-stress levels rose under the ongoing Very Hot Weather Warning, advising employers to arrange rest breaks for outdoor and…

zh.headline: 黃色工作暑熱警告下午生效
zh.dek: 勞工處下午約1時15分發出黃色工作暑熱警告，表示部分工作環境熱壓力頗高；酷熱天氣警告同時生效，僱主應安排適當休息時間。

en.headline: Tsuen Wan construction site water main burst sends jet tens of metres high
en.dek: An underground water pipe ruptured at a roadside works site on Guo Rui Road near Summit Terrace around 11am, producing a water column estimated at about ten storeys high; the Water Supplies Department is carrying out…

zh.headline: 荃灣國瑞路工地爆水管 水柱高約十層樓
zh.dek: 周五上午11時許，荃灣國瑞路近昇柏山對開路邊工地有地底水管爆裂，水柱噴高約十層樓，水務署已到場關掣搶修。

en.headline: Woman loses nearly HK$69 million to scammers posing as mainland officials
en.dek: A 43-year-old Hong Kong woman transferred about HK$68.9 million over a month after callers claiming to be mainland law-enforcement officers accused her of a crime and demanded money to prove her innocence.

zh.headline: 女子墮假冒內地官員騙局 損失近6,900萬元
zh.dek: 一名43歲香港女子接獲自稱內地執法人員來電，指她涉案並要求轉帳「保證金」，一個月內合共轉出約6,890萬元至指定帳戶。

en.headline: HKMCA authorises BOC Life intermediaries to refer annuity plan
en.dek: Designated licensed insurance intermediaries of BOC Group Life Assurance may now introduce the HKMC Annuity Plan to customers and refer eligible clients under a new partnership announced Friday.

zh.headline: 年金公司與中銀人壽合作 授權中介介紹年金計劃
zh.dek: 香港按揭證券有限公司全資附屬的年金公司周五公布，中銀人壽指定持牌保險中介可向客戶介紹年金計劃並轉介合資格客戶。

en.headline: North Point water main burst disrupts supply on Fuk Yan Road
en.dek: A 250 mm fresh-water main burst at the junction of King Wah Road and Fuk Yan Road early Friday, cutting supply to nearby residences and shops; most service was restored by late morning with repairs continuing.

zh.headline: 北角福蔭道食水管爆裂 附近一度停水
zh.dek: 周五早上京華道與福蔭道交界一條250毫米食水管爆裂，附近住宅及食肆食水供應受影響，大部分用戶上午已恢復，搶修仍在進行。

en.headline: Government gazettes water recreation and yacht bay works near airport
en.dek: Proposed works by the Airport Authority in the bay between the airport, the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge Hong Kong Port and Tung Chung aim to create leisure and tourism facilities, with construction tentatively from…

zh.headline: 政府刊憲機場附近水上康樂及遊艇港灣工程
zh.dek: 機管局擬於機場、港珠澳大橋香港口岸與東涌之間海灣進行水上康樂及遊艇港灣發展工程，暫訂2027年展開、2030年完成。

en.headline: Election Committee subsector polls set for 22 November
en.dek: The Chief Executive has gazetted Sunday 22 November as the polling day for the 2026 Election Committee Subsector Ordinary Elections, with nominations running from 7 to 20 October.

zh.headline: 選委會界別分組選舉投票日定11月22日
zh.dek: 行政長官已刊憲指明2026年11月22日為選舉委員會界別分組一般選舉投票日，提名期由10月7日至20日。

en.headline: Law Society urges ‘law comes first’ in five-year plan submission
en.dek: The professional body submitted recommendations stressing that economic and social development must rest on a clear, predictable and internationally credible legal framework, and offered proposals on the Northern…

zh.headline: 律師會就五年規劃提交建議 強調「法律先行」
zh.dek: 律師會在意見書中強調經濟與社會發展願景須以清晰、可預測及具國際公信力的法律框架為基礎，並就北部都會區、仲裁及體育法等提出建議。

en.headline: Man arrested over H8 building sprinkler attack that disabled three lifts
en.dek: A 21-year-old man was arrested after a fire sprinkler head was smashed with a baseball bat on 1 August, flooding lift shafts at the Tsim Sha Tsui commercial building and putting all three lifts out of service for days.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀H8大廈花灑遭棒球棍破壞 21歲男子被捕
zh.dek: 一名21歲男子涉於8月1日以棒球棍擊毀消防花灑頭，導致三部升降機入水停運多日，警方已拘捕該男子並追緝另外四人。

en.headline: Police arrest 15 after Kwun Tong drug den raid
en.dek: Officers raided a unit on Shui Wo Street on Thursday, seizing suspected heroin, ice and other drugs with an estimated value of about HK$120,000; a 43-year-old woman was arrested for operating a drug den and trafficking.

zh.headline: 觀塘毒窟搜查 警拘15人檢約12萬元毒品
zh.dek: 警方周四在瑞和街一單位搜查，檢獲懷疑海洛英、冰毒等，市值約12萬元；一名43歲女子涉經營毒窟及販毒被捕。

en.headline: Lingnan University Students’ Union announces dissolution after 59 years
en.dek: The union said campus and external conditions had changed and it had taken the difficult decision to dissolve after a joint meeting, leaving only a handful of active student unions among the eight publicly funded…

zh.headline: 嶺南大學學生會宣布解散 結束近59年運作
zh.dek: 學生會稱近年校園內外形勢出現變化，經聯席會議通過後作出解散的艱難決定，八大資助大學僅剩少數學生會仍在運作。

en.headline: Very hot weather to continue, extremely hot over weekend
en.dek: The Observatory warns of prolonged high temperatures with parts of the New Territories expected to reach 36 degrees or above under the influence of outer subsiding air from Tropical Cyclone Dolphin.

zh.headline: 酷熱天氣持續 周末部分地區極端酷熱
zh.dek: 天文台指出受熱帶氣旋白海豚外圍下沉氣流影響，未來數日高溫持續，周末新界部分地區氣溫可達36度或以上。

en.headline: Happy Valley estate pool closed over suspected fake lifeguard certificate
en.dek: The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department ordered the immediate closure of a private swimming pool after a lifeguard’s credentials failed to match official records.

zh.headline: 跑馬地屋苑泳池疑用假救生員證 食環署令即時關閉
zh.dek: 食環署發現跑馬地雲地利道私人屋苑持牌泳池有救生員使用虛假證件，已指令泳池即時關閉，並考慮檢控持牌人。

en.headline: Alice Mak says Care Teams now key part of district governance
en.dek: The Secretary for Home and Youth Affairs told a training session for team leaders that the Care Teams, together with District Councils and the three committees, form the “three carriages” of local governance after…

zh.headline: 麥美娟：關愛隊已成地區治理重要一環
zh.dek: 民政及青年事務局局長在關愛隊培訓班表示，關愛隊成立三年已成為完善地區治理架構重要部分，與區議會及「三會」組成「三駕馬車」。

en.headline: Chan Kwok-ki inspects Huanggang Port, demands highest standards for drills
en.dek: The Chief Secretary visited the Hong Kong-side facilities on Thursday afternoon and said the inter-departmental team must complete more than 100 exercises and tests to the highest standard before the redeveloped…

zh.headline: 陳國基視察皇崗口岸 要求演練達最高標準
zh.dek: 政務司司長周四下午到港方口岸區實地視察，強調跨部門小組必須以最高標準完成逾百項演練及測試，確保通關安全暢順後才正式開通。

en.headline: CFS finds pre-packaged black cod exceeding methylmercury limit
en.dek: A sample of Alaska Seafood U.S. Alaska Black Cod Steak contained 0.8 mg/kg of methylmercury, above the legal limit of 0.5 mg/kg; the Centre for Food Safety ordered the affected batch withdrawn from sale and recalled.

zh.headline: 食安中心檢銀鱈魚扒甲基汞超標 受影響批次須下架回收
zh.dek: 一個預先包裝美國銀鱈魚扒樣本甲基汞含量每公斤0.8毫克，超出法例上限0.5毫克；食安中心已指令停售下架，進口商正回收。

en.headline: Bus driver arrested after motorcyclist critically injured in Tung Chung crash
en.dek: A 58-year-old motorcyclist was trapped under a bus and left unconscious after a collision at Tung Chung East Interchange on Thursday evening; the 60-year-old bus driver was arrested on suspicion of dangerous driving…

zh.headline: 東涌巴士電單車相撞 鐵騎士重傷昏迷 車長被捕
zh.dek: 周四傍晚東涌東交匯處一輛龍運巴士與電單車相撞，58歲鐵騎士被捲入車底拖行後昏迷送院，60歲巴士車長涉危險駕駛引致他人身體受嚴重傷害被捕。

en.headline: Customs seizes 8.12 million illicit cigarettes in two sea-container cases
en.dek: Officers arrested three local men after finding cigarettes hidden in a container declared as lifeboats from Singapore and another from South Korea declared as toiletries, with a combined estimated market value of…

zh.headline: 海關破兩宗海路私煙案 檢約812萬支拘3人
zh.dek: 關員在葵涌貨櫃碼頭先後截獲由新加坡及南韓抵港的貨櫃，分別以救生艇及牙膏護膚品作掩飾，共檢約812萬支懷疑未完稅香煙，市值約3700萬元。

en.headline: Government launches new silver bonds with 4.25% guaranteed rate
en.dek: The 11th batch targets HK$50 billion and may rise to HK$55 billion; applications open 21 August for residents born in or before 1967, with issuance on 15 September.

zh.headline: 新一批銀色債券保證息率4.25厘 最高發行額550億
zh.dek: 第11批銀債目標發行額500億元，可視乎認購反應上調至550億元；1967年或之前出生居民可於8月21日起認購，9月15日發行。

en.headline: Swire Pacific first-half underlying profit rises 43% to HK$7.84 billion
en.dek: The conglomerate reported higher contributions from property, beverages and aviation, declared an increased interim dividend and said it is making its largest-ever investments across businesses.

zh.headline: 太古上半年基本溢利升43%至78.4億元 中期息增15%
zh.dek: 太古股份公司公布中期業績，基本溢利78.43億元，地產、飲料及航空業務均有改善，A股派中期息1.5元。

en.headline: CUHK unveils five-year plan with new postgraduate college
en.dek: The Chinese University of Hong Kong will establish a tenth college dedicated to postgraduate students and reform general education to integrate national education with a global outlook under its 2026–2030 strategy.

zh.headline: 中大公布五年策略計劃 將設研究生書院增至10所
zh.dek: 中文大學發布《中大2026-2030》策略計劃，成立第10所書院專供研究生，並革新通識教育融合國民教育與全球視野。

en.headline: Tuen Ma Line delays after signal fault near Kam Sheung Road
en.dek: Services between Hung Hom and Tuen Mun were disrupted for about an hour on Thursday afternoon after signalling equipment failed, with journey times extended by up to 30 minutes before normal operations resumed.

zh.headline: 屯馬綫錦上路站附近信號故障 紅磡至屯門一度延誤
zh.dek: 港鐵下午1時許因錦上路站附近信號設備故障實施雙向行車，紅磡至屯門行車時間最多額外30分鐘，約2時23分修復後服務逐步恢復。

en.headline: Police arrest 25 in triad-linked loan-shark ring charging up to 282% interest
en.dek: The Organised Crime and Triad Bureau dismantled a syndicate that lent more than HK$200 million to about 2,000 people over a year, recruiting teenagers as young as 13 for debt collection.

zh.headline: O記破三合會高利貸集團拘25人 年利率高達282%
zh.dek: 警方搗破一個由三合會操控的高利貸集團，一年間向約2,000人放債逾2億元，招攬年僅13歲青少年淋紅油追債，凍結約840萬元犯罪得益。

en.headline: Four more men charged with murder over Tsim Sha Tsui bar killing
en.dek: Four men aged 26 to 33 appeared in Kowloon City Magistrates’ Courts on Thursday and were remanded in custody until 29 October pending further investigation.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀酒吧命案再多4人被控謀殺 還押至10月
zh.dek: 4名介乎26至33歲男子周四在九龍城裁判法院提堂，被控謀殺罪，暫不准保釋，還押至10月29日再訊。

en.headline: Man’s body recovered near Stonecutters Bridge, suspected drowning
en.dek: A man aged about 40 was found floating in the sea near Stonecutters Bridge early this morning; clothes recovered at a nearby private pier suggest he may have been swimming.

zh.headline: 昂船洲大橋附近海面撈起男屍 疑游泳遇溺
zh.dek: 今早8時許有人發現昂船洲大橋附近海面有人形物體載浮載沉，救援人員撈起一名約40歲男子，初步相信游泳期間遇溺。

en.headline: CLP first-half earnings rise 6.6% to HK$6.0 billion
en.dek: The power utility reported total earnings of HK$5,997 million for the six months to June, with operating earnings before fair value movements up 9.7%, and declared an unchanged second interim dividend of 63 HK cents.

zh.headline: 中電上半年盈利升6.6%至近60億元
zh.dek: 中電控股公布上半年總盈利59.97億元，按年升6.6%，計入公平價值變動前營運盈利升9.7%，派第二期中期股息每股0.63港元，與去年相同。

en.headline: Yellow Working Heat Stress Warning issued at midday
en.dek: The Labour Department activated the Yellow Working Heat Stress Warning shortly after midday as heat stress levels rose under the ongoing Very Hot Weather Warning.

zh.headline: 黃色工作暑熱警告中午生效
zh.dek: 勞工處中午約12時26分發出黃色工作暑熱警告，表示部分工作環境的熱壓力頗高，酷熱天氣警告同時生效。

en.headline: Chinese Chamber urges population of 10 million and annual plan review
en.dek: The Chinese General Chamber of Commerce submitted more than 60 recommendations on Hong Kong’s first five-year plan, including a target of 10 million residents within a decade and a standing committee to review…

zh.headline: 中總倡十年人口達千萬 五年規劃設一年一檢委會
zh.dek: 香港中華總商會就首份五年規劃及施政報告提出逾60項建議，包括未來十年逐步提升人口至1,000萬配合北都發展，並成立常設委員會每年檢視進度。

en.headline: Privacy chief warns of fake e-visa sites after 16 cases
en.dek: The Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data said 16 enquiries or complaints about fraudulent electronic-visa websites were received in three months, with losses of a few hundred to more than HK$1,700 per case.

zh.headline: 假電子簽證網站湧現 私隱署三個月接16宗
zh.dek: 私隱專員鍾麗玲表示過去三個月接獲16宗假冒電子簽證網站查詢或投訴，主要涉美、英、泰旅遊簽證，損失數百至一千七百多元，呼籲勿盡信搜尋引擎置頂結果。

en.headline: Salt-water pipe leak near Chi Lin Nunnery disrupts flush supply
en.dek: The Water Supplies Department is repairing a 300 mm salt-water main on Fung Tak Road after a leak reported in the early hours, affecting flush water to the Hammer Hill Road area.

zh.headline: 鑽石山鳳德道鹹水管滲漏 沖廁水受影響
zh.dek: 水務署凌晨接報鑽石山鳳德道近志蓮淨苑有水管滲漏，確認為300毫米鹹水管，正維修並盡快恢復斧山道近瓊東街一帶沖廁水供應。

en.headline: HK Electric opens smart operations centre to speed emergency repairs
en.dek: The centre, launched in June ahead of typhoon season, integrates AI, IoT sensors and live video links so engineers can locate cable faults and coordinate repairs more quickly.

zh.headline: 港燈啟用智能營運及緊急應變中心 加快搶修
zh.dek: 中心於6月風季前投入服務，結合人工智能、物聯網感應器及即時視像，協助迅速定位電纜故障及協調前線搶修。

en.headline: Woman, 67, arrested over HK$4.3 million rental crypto scam
en.dek: Police say the suspect posed as a tenant, prepaid rent to win trust, then supplied phones pre-loaded with fake investment app links that transferred control of victims’ wallets.

zh.headline: 六旬婦扮租客誘投資加密貨幣 呃兩業主430萬被捕
zh.dek: 西區警方指67歲女子假扮租客預支租金博信任，再提供預載虛假連結的手機，令兩名業主共損失約430萬元。

en.headline: Veteran lyricist and actor Peter Lai dies at 76
en.dek: The Cantopop pioneer, known for classics written with Sam Hui and his role as Uncle Pau in a long-running TVB sitcom, passed away on Wednesday morning after months of declining health.

zh.headline: 填詞人兼演員黎彼得因病離世 享年76歲
zh.dek: 殿堂級填詞人黎彼得周三早上離世，好友鍾志光證實消息，指他今年3月中風後一直臥床，家人希望低調處理後事。

en.headline: Very Hot Weather Warning issued this morning
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory activated the warning at 6.45am as mainly fine and very hot conditions are expected, with urban temperatures reaching about 33 degrees.

zh.headline: 酷熱天氣警告今早生效
zh.dek: 天文台上午6時45分發出酷熱天氣警告，預料今日大致天晴酷熱，市區最高氣溫約33度，新界再高兩三度。

en.headline: Centre for Health Protection confirms new local mpox case
en.dek: A 31-year-old man is in stable condition under isolation at Princess Margaret Hospital after testing positive; he reported high-risk contact with multiple strangers in Hong Kong during the incubation period.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心確認一宗本地猴痘個案 31歲男子情況穩定
zh.dek: 患者於瑪嘉烈醫院接受隔離治療，潛伏期內曾在港與多名陌生男子有高風險接觸，暫未發現與早前個案有流行病學關連。

en.headline: Health Department seizes about 100 boxes of unregistered painkillers
en.dek: Officers recovered suspected unregistered products carrying Japanese labels and containing ibuprofen and dihydrocodeine from a licensed pharmacy, a medicine shop and two other outlets; a 38-year-old man was arrested.

zh.headline: 衞生署檢約百盒懷疑未註冊止痛藥 38歲男子被捕
zh.dek: 署方在尖沙咀、銅鑼灣、上水及元朗突擊巡查，於一間持牌藥房、一間藥行及兩間店舖檢獲約100盒大多附日文標籤的懷疑未註冊藥劑製品，一名38歲男子涉非法管有被捕。

en.headline: Customs seizes 1.6 million illicit cigarettes in Sham Shui Po crackdown
en.dek: A series of operations from late July to 5 August netted about 1.6 million sticks valued at more than HK$7.2 million and led to 27 arrests, including four South Asian men identified as key members of a local syndicate.

zh.headline: 海關深水埗破南亞裔私煙集團 檢約160萬支私煙拘27人
zh.dek: 由7月23日至8月5日一連串行動檢獲約160萬支私煙，估計市值逾720萬元，應課稅值約530萬元，拘捕27人，當中包括4名南亞裔骨幹。

en.headline: Fatal traffic accidents rise 44% in first half of 2026
en.dek: Police recorded 59 fatal crashes and 63 deaths, up sharply from a year earlier, while overall injury accidents continued their long-term decline; a three-week enforcement drive has begun.

zh.headline: 上半年致命交通意外升44% 共63人死亡
zh.dek: 警方錄得59宗致命車禍，死亡人數較去年同期升47%；整體傷亡意外則繼續下降，並展開為期三周的專題執法行動。

en.headline: Tung Wah College apologises for false JUPAS admission emails to 11,000
en.dek: Human error caused an acceptance notice intended for successful applicants to be sent to every one of the 11,139 people who applied through JUPAS, the college said after issuing a rapid clarification.

zh.headline: 東華學院誤向1.1萬聯招申請人發取錄電郵致歉
zh.dek: 校方指因人為操作疏忽，將原擬發給獲取錄者的確認電郵誤發予全部11,139名申請人，已即時澄清並成立危機小組跟進。

en.headline: Financial Secretary ends investigation into Next Digital affairs
en.dek: Paul Chan directed the inspector to terminate the probe after the company was wound up, delisted and related national-security convictions were secured, saying further inquiry was no longer necessary.

zh.headline: 財政司司長指示終止調查壹傳媒事務
zh.dek: 陳茂波經審視清盤、除牌及國安相關定罪等情況後，認為已無需要繼續調查，並指示審查員終止有關工作。

en.headline: Labour Department tests infrared drones to enforce construction site smoking ban
en.dek: Officials have issued 39 fixed-penalty notices and 11 advisories since the ban took effect on 17 July, describing compliance as unsatisfactory and exploring AI-assisted detection.

zh.headline: 勞工處試用紅外線無人機巡查地盤禁煙
zh.dek: 禁煙令7月17日生效後已發出39張定額罰款通知書及11張敦促改善通知書，當局指合規情况未如理想，並研究結合人工智能偵測。

en.headline: Cathay Pacific first-half profit rises 71% to HK$6.24 billion
en.dek: The group posted its strongest interim result since 2010 on solid passenger and cargo demand, declaring a first interim dividend of 26 HK cents per share.

zh.headline: 國泰上半年溢利升71%至62.4億元
zh.dek: 集團錄得2010年以來最強中期業績，乘客及貨運需求穩健，宣布派發第一次中期股息每股26港仙。

en.headline: HK Express cancels Okinawa and Ishigaki flights as Typhoon Dolphin approaches
en.dek: Multiple services between Hong Kong and Okinawa from Thursday to Saturday, plus Saturday Ishigaki flights, are cancelled; the carrier added an extra pair of flights on Wednesday.

zh.headline: 白海豚逼近 香港快運取消沖繩石垣多班航班
zh.dek: 周四至周六多班往返沖繩航班及周六石垣航班取消，快運周三已加開特別航班疏導旅客。

en.headline: JUPAS offers places to 34.3% of applicants as competition rises
en.dek: Some 15,619 students secured university or subsidised diploma places in the main round, down slightly from last year as total applicants rose 5.3% to 45,545.

zh.headline: 聯招正式遴選34.3%申請人獲派位 競爭加劇
zh.dek: 15,619名考生獲八大、都大或教大資助高級文憑學額，申請人數按年升5.3%至45,545人，取錄比率較去年微跌。

en.headline: Legionnaires’ disease linked to hospital water dispenser
en.dek: An 89-year-old patient at Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital is highly likely to have contracted the disease from a cooled-boiled-water device that tested positive for Legionella, the Centre for Health Protection said.

zh.headline: 養和醫院退伍軍人病個案與飲水機有關
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心表示，一名89歲男病人很大可能因飲用受污染的凍開水飲水機供水而感染退伍軍人病，同層137名病人已納入醫學監察。

en.headline: Very Hot Weather Warning issued this morning
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory activated the warning at 6.45am as temperatures climbed under mainly fine and very hot conditions expected through the day.

zh.headline: 酷熱天氣警告今早生效
zh.dek: 天文台上午6時45分發出酷熱天氣警告，預料今日大致天晴酷熱，日間市區最高氣溫約33度。

en.headline: Property sales fall 28.8% in July from previous month
en.dek: The Land Registry recorded 6,715 sale and purchase agreements for all building units last month, with residential agreements down 41.7% to 4,462.

zh.headline: 7月物業買賣合約按月跌28.8%
zh.dek: 土地註冊處錄得6,715份所有樓宇單位買賣合約，住宅單位合約跌41.7%至4,462份。

en.headline: Police arrest six over Fun Coffee cryptocurrency investment scam
en.dek: A joint operation with Macau police netted five women and one man aged 51 to 64; authorities have received 225 reports involving suspected losses of about HK$94 million.

zh.headline: 警拘六人涉「Fun Coffee」加密貨幣投資騙案
zh.dek: 與澳門警方聯合行動拘捕五女一男，年齡介乎51至64歲；本港接獲225宗舉報，涉款約9,400萬元。

en.headline: Boy, 7, suffers minor injury after KMB bus wheel detaches in Cheung Sha Wan
en.dek: A rear-left wheel came off a route 86 double-decker outside Cheung Sha Wan Plaza on Tuesday afternoon, struck a railing and hit the child waiting at a bus stop.

zh.headline: 九巴長沙灣車胎甩脫擊傷七歲男童
zh.dek: 一輛86線雙層巴士周二下午在長沙灣廣場外左後車輪甩脫，撞向欄杆後擊中在巴士站候車的男童，男童輕傷。

en.headline: Seven-year-old boy dies in first fatal paediatric flu case of 2026
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection said the previously healthy child, who had received the seasonal vaccine, died on Tuesday after developing shock and encephalopathy from influenza A (H3).

zh.headline: 七歲男童感染甲型流感不治 成今年首宗兒童死亡個案
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心表示，該名過往健康良好並已接種季節性流感疫苗的男童，周二因甲型流感（H3）併發休克及腦病變死亡。

en.headline: FEHD foreman charged with misconduct over bogus littering tickets
en.dek: The ICAC charged a 41-year-old Food and Environmental Hygiene Department officer with misconduct in public office after he allegedly issued five false fixed-penalty notices that led to court warrants and one wrongful…

zh.headline: 食環署管工涉發虛假垃圾票 被廉政公署控公職人員行為失當
zh.dek: 一名41歲食環署管工被控向五人發出虛假定額罰款通知書，導致法庭發出拘捕令及一人被錯誤拘捕，案件由廉政公署跟進。

en.headline: Retail sales rise 4.6% in June for 14th consecutive month
en.dek: The value of total retail sales reached HK$31.5 billion in June, with online sales up 11.6% and jewellery and watches jumping more than 20%, the Census and Statistics Department said.

zh.headline: 6月零售銷售額按年升4.6% 連續14個月增長
zh.dek: 政府統計處公布，6月零售業總銷貨價值暫定為315億元，按年升4.6%，網上銷售升11.6%，珠寶首飾、鐘錶及名貴禮物銷售升逾兩成。
